S.FORM: == kakiliman == sakatusa lekad ni Cwan-pu amalacungtung a sapat川普第二屆任期關稅 Tang-na·Cwan-pu i sakatusa lekad Amilika a kalacungtungan yadah ku nikawawan tu micunus tu sata, I 2025 a mihca 4 a bulad 2 a demiad m usakamu "palalecad tu sata" "kamu nu Ing, Reciprocal Tariff" sakay kitakit a gingku mutesek ku nikasasetul. hatini katene ku nipalekal ni Cwan-pu tu micumuday a sata, misudang kalaliaca atu micuay cinizaan "hinisa mipenec midisdis" ku Amilika a kanatal. Cwan-pu a sakatusa lekad a kalacungtungan a sata pacaub tu sapisiwbay nu Amilika misabalucu' midiput macakat lekakawa. Kanahatu ci Cwan-pu i saayaway lekad a cen-bu sakay 3800 walwalen Amilika a kalisiw micumuday a tuud niala a sata, nika palaayaw katukuh 2025 a mihca 4 a bulad, u sakatusa lekad niza malacungtung piala nu cen-bu tu sata pulunng a kalisiw malakui' ku 1.4 walwalen Amilika a kalisiw Cwan-pu i 2025 a mihca 1 a bulad muliyaw aca malacungtung, zikuz atu Cong-hwa-zen-min-kung-he-kow nu misiwbayay malalid ku nikalepacaw,m akay 4 a bulad 11 a demiad malingatu uynian a kanatal macakat tu 145% pesen ku sata. palekal tu sakatus tu sakay Cya-na-ta atu Mu-si-ke ngayaw nu misiwbayay, hamin nu Cya-na-ta atu Mu-si-ke a tuud niala tu sata 25% pesen. nika zikauz caay tu piala tu matatungusay a USMCA "nikaketunan nu Mey-Mu-Cya a tuud. Cwan-pu uyni a kawaw paketun miazih tuyni a kanatal tu sakay mikuliniway tu ledek a tuud atu situngus tu sunuk sanay malimad, namahini micukel tu kanatalay nu misangaa' a kawaw. 2025 a mihca 3 a bulad 4 a dimiad, ci Cwan-pu hamin nu Cong-hwa-zen-min-kung-he-kow sata nu micumuday a tuud macakat tu 20% pesen. miala haca ciniza tu 25% pesan a sata nu Cya-na-ta atu Mu-si-ke, nika zikuz caay tu piala tu sata nu misiwbayay a tuud, katukuh 4 a bulad 2 a demiad. ci Cwan-pu patabaki aca i hami nu hekal tu sata, sakay hekalay mukin atu alumi a tuud miala tu 25% pesen ku sata, uyni a lekakawa I 3 a bulad 12 a dem iad malingatu. 4 a bulad 2 a demiad, ci Cwan-pu misabalucu' mihapiw tu hamin nu hekalay a sata, makay 4 a bulad 5 a demiad malingatu pasayza hamin nu hekalay hamin nu micumiday a tuud nu misiwbayay micunus tu micumuday a sata tu 10% pesen, 4 a bulad 9 a demiad malingatu pasayza 60 a kanatal micunus tu zumaay a sate. 4 a bulad 3 a demiad malingatu, hami nu micumuday tayza Amilika kazizeng miala tu sata 25% pesan kazizeng a keysi paayaw malecad amala. Cya-na-ta Cong-hwa-zen-min-kung-he-kow atu Ow-mung masakamu tu amiala tu sata a kawaw, zuma a kanatal amalingatu atu Amilika cen-bu masakalah misudang, amikawaw, amilawa' tu kayadah nu kacaculi nu misiwbayay. 4月3日起, . malalitin tu i hekalay atu zumaay a natinengan
